mars_gravity_m_s2.note: Working surface gravity value (fact sheet mean 3.73 m/s^2).

crew_body_mass_kg.source_title: Standard reference astronaut body mass for Pandolf carriage model

carried_load_default_kg.source_title: Scenario EVA tool + sample + pack mass L
carried_load_default_kg.note: User-configurable carried load L in kg.

walk_v_max_mps.source_title: Apollo Lunar Surface Journal 'Lunar Gaits' (working pace 1.1-2.2 km/h, walkback 3.6 km/h)
walk_v_max_mps.note: Reference level walking speed V_max; modulated by piecewise slope function V(theta).

pandolf_equation.source_title: Pandolf, Givoni & Goldman (1977), J Appl Physiol 43(4):577-581
pandolf_equation.note: 1-g empirical load-carriage equation applied to Mars walk planning as a scenario model (untested at 0.38g); floored at HIDH suited minimum 144 W.

suit_overhead_kappa.source_title: Norcross et al. (2010), NASA/TP-2010-216115 (MKIII 3/8-g suit overhead)
suit_overhead_kappa.note: Suited locomotion overhead multiplier applied to Pandolf metabolic power.

o2_energy_kj_per_l.source_title: Weir (1949) / Scott (2005) PMC2129144 (~2.9 mL O2/min per W)
o2_energy_kj_per_l.note: Standard mixed-diet respiratory exchange conversion between metabolic watts and O2 consumption.

nominal_o2_tank_liters.source_title: EMU Data Book Rev V (0.55 kg primary ~385 L + secondary reserve context)
nominal_o2_tank_liters.note: Scenario consumables tank size slider; 0.55 kg O2 is ~385 L STP, 8h PLSS-class sortie context.

max_slope_deg.source_title: Apollo EVA slope experience (<25 deg accessible, Iqbal 2024) + Curiosity 23 deg rover reroute
max_slope_deg.note: Team planning hard limit governed by 5m/10m block max-slope (slope_max_deg); configurable default.

return_reserve_fraction.source_title: Anchored conceptually to NASA EVA Walkback Test (NASA/TP-2009-214796)
return_reserve_fraction.note: Team policy assumption (25% consumables reserve kept for turn-back / PNR).

rad_baseline_msv_per_day.note: Single roving point measurement at Curiosity in Gale Crater; no spatial radiation map exists.
